description: Data models used by the Mission Management UI.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user with id, name, email, and roles.

classes.name: Donation
classes.description: Represents donation details including donor name, amount, date, and status.

classes.name: Volunteer
classes.description: Represents a volunteer with id, name, region, and phone number.

classes.name: MissionProject
classes.description: Represents a mission project with id, name, region, and status.

classes.name: ActivityItem
classes.description: Represents an activity with id, title, subtitle, and timestamp.

classes.name: OverviewStats
classes.description: Aggregated statistics including donations month-to-date, active volunteers, projects, and pending tasks.
